create_meltingpot_env: create a MeltingpotEnv with a given substrate name, categorical actions, and device using MeltingPotClass get_env_fun
get_env_transforms: get a list of TorchRL transforms including DoubleToFloat and FlattenObservation for INTERACTION_INVENTORIES keys
get_replay_buffer_transforms: get DTypeCastTransform for RGB observation keys to cast uint8 to float for replay buffer storage
get_observation_spec: get the observation spec filtered to only include group keys present in the environment group map
get_state_spec: get the global state spec containing only the RGB key from the environment observation spec
